'''''Goeppertia orbifolia''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the family ''[[Marantaceae]]''.<ref name=POWO>{{cite web |url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:60461168-2 |title= Goeppertia orbifolia (Linden) Borchs. & S.Suárez |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=n.d. |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=June 25, 2025}}</ref> This [[Prayer plant (Calathea)|prayer plant]] is sometimes known by its [[synonym (taxonomy)|synonym]] ''Calathea orbifolia''.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.theplantlist.org/tpl/record/kew-223166|title=Calathea orbifolia (Linden) H.A.Kenn. — The Plant List|website=www.theplantlist.org|language=en|access-date=2018-05-25}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.catalogueoflife.org/annual-checklist/2010/details/species/id/7253605|title=Catalogue of Life - 2010 Annual Checklist :: Species details|website=www.catalogueoflife.org|language=en|access-date=2018-05-25}}</ref> It is endemic to Brazil, being a typical species of the [[Atlantic Forest]]. It is commonly kept as a houseplant in temperate zones for its ornamental leaves.<ref>[https://reflora.jbrj.gov.br/reflora/listaBrasil/FichaPublicaTaxonUC/FichaPublicaTaxonUC.do?id=FB138814 Reflora - Lista de Espécies do Brasil]</ref> It requires partial shade, humidity, and good drainage to thrive.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://garden.org/plants/view/333848/Goeppertia-orbifolia/|title=Goeppertia orbifolia - Garden.org|website=garden.org|language=en|access-date=2018-05-25}}</ref>
